description: MUTATES the authenticated user Food Diary and calendar. Use when they ate or drank — do not store this as a chat memory. Example: “I had Mee Pok for late lunch with my parents” → log_food({ what: "Mee Pok", kind: "meal", meal_period: "late lunch", with: ["my parents"] }). Optional: place/merchant, amount, consumed_at (ISO). Resolves with/Mum/Dad via person aliases; unknown names do not fail the food write. Tags companions on the mirrored event. Rebuilds life_state. Requires API key or OAuth with scope context. Share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

meal_period.description: Spoken period when consumed_at is omitted, e.g. "late lunch"

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

what.description: What they ate or drank (required). Example: Mee Pok

with.description: Companion names, aliases, ids, or group tokens. "my parents" / Mum / Dad resolve via aliases; "family" expands to CRM rows with family relationship labels

name: log_food

items.description: A Dayze person or contact record.

title: Log Food (diary write)
